description: RealtyTrac foreclosure listings for a US city or ZIP: bank-owned (REO) and auction homes with property type, address, county, beds, baths, living and lot square feet, RealtyTrac estimated value, estimated ROI, online auction partner, auction date/time, status and update dates, coordinates and listing URL; 24 per page plus total count. Pre-foreclosure details are mostly withheld for anonymous visitors, so that filter often returns nothing. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City name, e.g. atlanta or 'el paso' (give city+state, or zip)

zip.description: Optional 5-digit ZIP inside the city (needs city+state), e.g. 30331

name: realestate_realtytrac
